newsitem.title: USA: Collagen sees Q4 EPS in estimate range.
newsitem.headline: Collagen sees Q4 EPS in estimate range.

text.p: Collagen Corp on Wednesday said that it expects its fourth quarter and full year earnings to fall within the range of analysts' estimates, excluding the gain from the sale of Prograft Medical Inc.
Analysts expect Collagen to report a loss of $0.24 per share for both the fourth quarter and full year, according to First Call.
Reported earnings per share, however, are expected to be significantly above analysts' estimates due primarily to the gain from the sale of Prograft Medical Inc, it said.
During the fiscal fourth quarter, Collagen sold its 18 percent stake in privately held Prograft Medical Inc to W.L. Gore and Associates Inc for $15.4 million.
